headline: Mexican stock market heads for sixth decline and already loses more than 3% in its losing streak
summary: Mexican indexes are extending a losing streak and are set to fall for a sixth session after reaching a recent record high. The move follows weakness in peer markets abroad.
why: The S&P/BMV IPC is Mexico's main benchmark equity index, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
original_headline: Bolsa mexicana perfila sexta caída y ya pierde más de 3% en su racha negativa
